name: Lovestrike
source:
Meet West, our genderless protagonist.

West is a successful student at their school, Horizon Valley High, and they have a friend who always hangs out and talks to them after class. It's always been like that for six months now. Or at least....

UNTIL ONE STRANGE NIGHT...

West had a strangely surreal dream. They dreamt that a mysterious deity came into their house one night and stained their vision with a horrible curse.

After West woke up, and got dressed for school, they discover that the curse wasn't just a dream. It was actually real. And that's baaaaad news for them.

You must be the guide that helps West make decisions, whether they're good or bad. Whatever choices you make will help unravel the secrets their world has been hiding, thus piecing together the full story behind the horrible curse that followed.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/THIRD-EYE/305389] Gamejolt[/url]]
